statement: hotarubukuro is the biographical and epistemic origin of the zuizui research universe while remaining Chapter 3 in the reconstructed flower-colour series.
public_line: 一つの花色多型を畳めなかったことが、すべての座標を開いた。
epistemic_move: Keep the original polymorphic system open instead of closing it under one cause; branch the question into space, evolutionary time, phenotype resolution, ecological context, observation and identification, then return those coordinates to the same system.
preserves: The unresolved empirical origin and the loop by which questions derived from it later re-resolve the origin.
refuses: Treating hotarubukuro only as a later empirical example or only as the third chapter of the flower-colour series.

semantics.origin_edge: biographical and epistemic provenance, not scientific dependence or transfer of claim ownership
semantics.chapter_path: analytical reconstruction of questions, not research chronology
semantics.return: the later analytical coordinates are brought back to the original focal polymorphic system

claim_firewall: The origin relation does not make hotarubukuro the scientific owner of results, data or theorems produced by other repositories.
The flower-colour chapter order remains fcp, chun, hotarubukuro when read as an analytical sequence.
Portfolio provenance is distinct from citation, causal dependence, code dependence and theorem dependence.
